description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'Ambiorix' for interacting with data model objects in a network management context. It declares methods for setting and reading parameters, managing instances, handling time, and managing sub-objects within the data model.

classes.name: Ambiorix
classes.description: An abstract interface class providing methods to interact with network data models, including setting, reading, adding/removing instances, and managing sub-objects.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set a parameter value within the data model object, supporting multiple data types.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Read a parameter value from the data model object, supporting multiple data types.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Add an instance of an object type within the data model.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Remove an instance at a specific index within a collection.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieve the index of a specific instance based on a key (e.g., ID or MAC address).

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Get the current date and time formatted according to RFC3339.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Remove all instances of a specified object type within the data model.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Instantiate an optional sub-object within the data model.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Remove an optional sub-object from the data model.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Set the current date and time in a specified object parameter.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Set a specific timestamp in a specified object parameter.
